summary: Missing Stripe webhook events: subscription.created, payment_failed, async_*

resolution.note: Migration 011 adds users.payment_state. Webhook handles invoice.payment_failed (sets past_due) and invoice.payment_succeeded (clears). Critically: subscription.updated past_due no longer demotes — Stripe is still retrying, so we keep tier='pro' and surface a banner. Nav-bar renders past-due banner with Update Payment CTA.
